results.basis: O. Reg. 367/11, Schedule 4.1, s. 4(1): 'the amount is calculated using the following formula: 80% AMR - [(AFNI x 0.30)/12]'; para 4.i takes AMR from 'the posted CMHC average market rent data'; para 5: "'CMHC average market rent data' means the average market rent data by rental market area as determined by the rental market survey conducted annually by the Canada Mortgage and Housing Corporation." RE-CITED 2026-10-24 (HANDOFF §3 item 5b(a)): the e-Laws page https://www.ontario.ca/laws/regulation/110367 is a JavaScript shell to curl, which is why this edge sat at C. The same publisher serves the regulation itself as a Word document at https://www.ontario.ca/laws/docs/110367_e.doc (HTTP 200, 1.8 MB, read in the cloud container with TLS verification on), and that document carries Schedule 4.1's formula and its definition verbatim. The citation moves to that copy; the quote is the definition of 'CMHC average market rent data'.

targetReport.title: CMHC Rental Market Survey / Rental Market Report (average and median market rents)
targetReport.description: CMHC's annual survey of the primary rental market (privately initiated rental structures with three or more units), conducted each October and published as the Rental Market Report with accompanying data tables. It produces both average market rent (AMR) and median market rent (MMR) series by unit size and rental market area, which provincial residual housing-benefit formulas name as their rent benchmark — Ontario and Nova Scotia use the average, Manitoba the median.
targetReport.cadence_note: Survey conducted each October; the Rental Market Report and data tables are published in the following months (recent editions in December-January).

Note CMHC also publishes a separate 'Mid-Year Rental Market Update' around July each year, but that is a distinct, smaller-scope product from the main annual Rental Market Report covered by this corpus entry.
